empty..hv/MAP.md:
# Project map

AI-facing index of subsystems. Detail files live in `.hv/map/<name>.md` and are loaded on demand via `.hv/bin/hv-map-query <name>`. The thin always-on summary in `CLAUDE.md` is regenerated by `.hv/bin/hv-map-index`.

Write `.hv/map/<name>.md` files describing subsystems as you discover them. Cycle skills (`/hv-work`, `/hv-debug`, `/hv-go`) bump `touched:` post-cycle on subsystems whose key files or entry points overlap the cycle's changes.
